purpose: Complete the pre-outcome decision rules for selection-gradient shift, multivariate response, realized finite trajectory, correlational selection, and history-dependent branching.

beta_shift.unit: derivative of log rare-mutant parental genome contribution per unit trait
beta_shift.robust_history_support: at least 90% of paired histories in the target quadrant
beta_shift.history_level_inference: paired bootstrap 95% CI of each mean component excludes zero in target direction; 1999 resamples; RNG seed 1004

absolute_sign_reversal.target: near beta_i >= +0.05, near beta_a <= -0.05, far beta_i <= -0.05, far beta_a >= +0.05

multivariate_response.exact_identity: Delta zbar = Cov(z,w)/mean(w) must match genotype-density next-generation mean to <=1e-12 under mutation=0, immigration=0, survival=0
multivariate_response.lande_approximation: Delta z_Lande = G beta using the full 2x2 investment-assurance covariance including off-diagonal G_ia
multivariate_response.local_fidelity_gate: cosine similarity >=0.90 and component signs match exact Price response
multivariate_response.syndrome_response: standardized exact Price response has investment <= -0.02 SD and assurance >= +0.02 SD

correlational_selection.estimand: mixed second derivative of rare-mutant log invasion fitness, gamma_ia = d2 log w_mut /(di_mut da_mut) at mutant=resident
correlational_selection.numerical_rule: symmetric four-point mixed finite difference with h=1e-4; confirm sign stability at h=5e-5 and 2e-4
correlational_selection.interpretation: negative gamma_ia supports antagonistic coupling but does not prove multiple attractors

realized_finite_abm.syndrome_endpoint: terminal Delta investment <= -0.05 AND terminal Delta assurance >= +0.05
realized_finite_abm.outcross_endpoint: terminal Delta investment >= +0.05 AND terminal Delta assurance <= -0.05
realized_finite_abm.branching_support: within one setting, both endpoint classes each represent >=10% of eligible histories
realized_finite_abm.occupancy: reported unconditionally; endpoint classification requires occupation at baseline and terminal

promotion_rules.si_only: beta shift supported but no realized branching
promotion_rules.mechanistic_core: beta shift plus response support, with either assurance sign reversal or realized syndrome endpoint
promotion_rules.repeatability_core_or_next_paper: alternative endpoint classes each >=10% and endpoint class depends on visitor history/initial state under fixed setting
promotion_rules.no_promotion: control-only assurance result or failure of rare-mutant/Price validation

fixed_delta_boundary: Inbreeding depression is fixed. No purging feedback is present, so any alternative endpoints or bistability are conditional on fixed delta and are not identified with the Lande-Schemske purging mechanism.
